name: Xal'atath
description: A ranged damage dealer who manipulates void energy to overwhelm enemies and control the battlefield.
title: The Harbinger of the Void
info: For eons, Xal'atath has manipulated gods and mortals alike to ascend the cosmic ladder. Once a servant of Dimensius the All-Devouring, and then a prisoner of the Old Gods, Xal'atath has now attained her freedom and set her own plans in motion—starting with the destruction of Dalaran and the transformation of the Sunwell.

Xalatath.name: Shadow Mark
Xalatath.description: Shoot a Void Orb that deals 45 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit, and an additional 90 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the center.  If a Hero is hit by the center, they are marked for 4 seconds.  Heroes afflicted by Shadow Mark are Revealed and draw the Dark Heart and Void Minions towards them.

Xalatath.name: Dark Heart Ritual
Xalatath.description: Summon the Dark Heart, which pulses for 35 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies and lasts 8 seconds.  The Dark Heart moves to Shadow Mark's impact location.  The Dark Heart will pursue Heroes afflicted by Shadow Mark and detonate on impact, dealing 180 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and +90 (+4% per level) damage to the marked target.

Xalatath.name: Void Step
Xalatath.description: Cast to teleport Xal'atath 3 times in a triangular pattern.  Each time Xal'atath teleports, her Basic Attacks deal +25% more damage while the Ability is active.  Reactivate to end Void Step early and remain at your current location.

Xalatath.name: Void Eruption
Xalatath.description: Channel a powerful Void Orb that grows over time until reaching maximum size after 2 seconds. Recast to launch the Orb early.  Enemies that come into contact with the Orb take 112 (+4% per level) damage and are Blinded for 1 second.  When the Orb reaches the end of its path, it detonates in a large explosion, dealing 400 (+4% per level) damage.  Charging up this Ability increases its contact damage up to 175 (+4% per level) and its explosion damage up to 700 (+4% per level).  Contact damage is dealt every 0.25 seconds.

Xalatath.name: Void Convergence
Xalatath.description: After channeling for 2 seconds, summon a Void Portal that spawns up to 3 Void Minions to attack nearby enemies.  You can have up to 1 active Void Portals.  Enemies near the Void Portal are Slowed by 25%.  Void Minions are attracted to Heroes afflicted by Shadow Mark.  The Portal expires after 12 seconds. Void Minion Basic Attacks deal 95 (+4% per level) damage per hit. Void Minions lose Health over 10 seconds.

Xalatath.name: Void Volley
Xalatath.description: After charging with her Basic Attacks 5 times, Xal'atath can activate Void Volley to unleash a barrage of Void Orbs at a target location, each dealing 99 (+4% per level) damage on impact. Charges will decay if Xal'atath is out of combat for more than 5 seconds.  Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Void Volley to grant 1 stack per hit and increases all Void damage by 0.1%. Upon dying lose all stacks.  Reward (30 Stacks):   +2 Void Volley Range   Stack loss on death lowered to 6.  .Reward (55 Stacks):   -1 Basic Attack required to charge Void Volley  Mythic Reward (90 Stacks):   +50% Basic Attack and Ability Damage.   Void Volley projectiles Pierce all targets.  Stack loss will never cause the hero to fall below a quest reward threshold.

1.name: Toxic Mark
1.description: +1s Shadow Mark Duration  Heroes affliced with Shadow Mark have their Armor reduced by -15 and take damage equal to 1% of their maximum Health every second.

1.name: Anchored Core
1.description: Dark Heart Ritual: +50% Radius +50% Duration  Dark Heart damage bounces 2 times from the primary target to nearby enemies, dealing 18 (+4% per level) damage.

1.name: Cloak of Shadows
1.description: Activating Void Step grants 50% Movement Speed and 25 Spell Armor for 2 seconds. This bonus refreshes each time Xal'atath teleports.

4.name: Cold Feet
4.description: +1s Shadow Mark Duration  Heroes afflicted by Shadow Mark have their Movement Speed reduced by -25%.

4.name: Dark Barrier
4.description: Each time Dark Heart damages an enemy, Xal'atath gains a Shield equal to 2% of her maximum Health, up to 10%.

4.name: Void Acolyte
4.description: Completing Void Step fully charges Void Volley.  The next Void Volley deals 50% increased damage and costs no Mana.

7.name: Void Adept
7.description: Quest: Detonate the Dark Heart on Heroes afflicted by Shadow Mark to increase the damage of Shadow Mark by 5 damage per hit, up to 100 damage.

7.name: Silence of the Lamb
7.description: Activating Void Step summons a seal of void magic on the ground. When the seal completes, it deals 99 (+4% per level) damage to enemies inside and Silences them for 2 seconds.

7.name: Void Summoner
7.description: Activating Void Step summons a single Void Minion in its center. Void Minions are attracted to Heroes afflicted by Shadow Mark.  Void Minion Basic Attacks deal 95 (+4% per level) damage per hit. Void Minion loses Health over 10 seconds.

10.name: Void Eruption
10.description: Channel a powerful Void Orb that grows over time until reaching maximum size after 2 seconds. Recast to launch the Orb early.  Enemies that come into contact with the Orb take 112 (+4% per level) damage and are Blinded for 1 second.  When the Orb reaches the end of its path, it detonates in a large explosion, dealing 400 (+4% per level) damage.  Charging up this Ability increases its contact damage up to 175 (+4% per level) and its explosion damage up to 700 (+4% per level).  Contact damage is dealt every 0.25 seconds.

10.name: Void Convergence
10.description: After channeling for 2 seconds, summon a Void Portal that spawns up to 3 Void Minions to attack nearby enemies.  You can have up to 1 active Void Portals.  Enemies near the Void Portal are Slowed by 25%.  Void Minions are attracted to Heroes afflicted by Shadow Mark.  The Portal expires after 12 seconds. Void Minion Basic Attacks deal 95 (+4% per level) damage per hit. Void Minions lose Health over 10 seconds.

13.name: Crushing Cascade
13.description: Enemies hit by Void Volley are Slowed by -6% for 2 seconds per projectile, up to 50%.

13.name: Pull of the Dark Heart
13.description: Enemies damaged by the Dark Heart Ritual are Slowed by 10% for each pulse, stacking up to 5 times and decaying over 2 seconds.

13.name: Dark Heart's Protection
13.description: Casting Dark Heart Ritual Silences enemies inside its radius for 2 second.  Xal'atath and allied Heroes gain 30 Spell Armor while inside the Dark Heart's radius.

16.name: Marked Resilience
16.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes afflicted by Shadow Mark grant a 480 (+4% per level) point Shield that rapidly decays.

16.name: Fractured Reality
16.description: +25% Void Volley Projectile Damage  Void Volley projectiles leave a trail of fire along their path for 3 seconds, dealing 45 (+4% per level) damage over time.  The trail deals damage every 1 second.

16.name: Relentless Whispers
16.description: While Void Step is active, Xal'atath's Basic Attack Speed is increased by 200%.

20.name: Harbinger's Consumption
20.description: Xal'atath's Void Eruption splits into 3 orbiting Void Orbs. Cancelling the Ability early causes the orbs to travel faster.

20.name: Rift Invasion
20.description: Void Convergence's Void Portal no longer has a life duration, raises the active Void Portal limit to 2, and can spawn and sustain up to 4 Void Minions.

20.name: Dueling Orbs
20.description: +1 Shadow Mark Charge  Shadow Mark has a 3 second cooldown between uses.

20.name: Unstable Core
20.description: When the Dark Heart expires or detonates on a Hero afflicted by Shadow Mark, it leaves behind a pool of void flames for 5 seconds. Enemies in the flames take 45 (+4% per level) damage over time.  The flames deal damage every 1 second.

20.name: Paradox Loop
20.description: After completing Void Step, Xal'atath immediately performs a second Void Step in the opposite direction. Added effects are triggered again.
